findings.quote: A cookie jar contains 300 cookies. Emma and her 3 friends take 1/3 of the cookies and decide to divide them equally among themselves. One of Emma's friends is on a diet and returns 8 of her cookies to the jar. Later, her brother Max comes home and takes 10 fewer cookies than those taken in total by Emma and her friends so he can also share with his classmates. What's the total number of cookies left in the jar?
